_meta.description: Monitored location set for the JalDrishti prototype. Flood-prone urban centres and district headquarters across India, chosen for river-basin and coastal diversity.
_meta.note: Terrain fields (elevation, slope, drainage density, distance to river) are NOT hand-written here. They are derived from real DEM + OpenStreetMap data by scripts/enrich_locations.py into locations.enriched.json.
_meta.population_source: Census of India 2011, urban agglomeration / city figures

derived_fields.slope_deg: finite-difference slope over a +-0.02 deg DEM stencil
derived_fields.drainage_density_km_per_km2: OSM waterway length / area of a 8.0 km disc
derived_fields.dist_to_water_km: great-circle distance to nearest OSM river/canal/water body
derived_fields.glofas_lat/glofas_lon: GloFAS cell with the largest mean discharge in a 5x5 probe window on a 0.05 deg pitch
